backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining an Inquiry type and three functions: submitInquiry (stores a new inquiry), getAllInquiries (returns all as array), and exportInquiriesCsv (returns CSV text of all inquiries).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report JSON documenting implemented features, primarily the replacement of body text in the OurLegacy page with Nexiris Global's company history and brand narrative content.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summary catalogue describing the purpose and recent changes of each frontend source file, serving as a build planning reference for the Nexiris Global frontend.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom property color tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, and chart variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with full SEO metadata including title, description, Open Graph, Twitter Card tags, and a JSON-LD Organization schema for Nexiris Global.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for Home, AnnualProgram, and OurLegacy pages, a shared Layout with Navigation/Footer/InquiryModal, and a ModalContext provider with useModal hook.
frontend/src/components/annual/FAQSectio: A FAQ section for the annual program page that renders a list of six accordion items covering verification reports, turnaround times, pricing, and Trade Trust Score details.
frontend/src/components/annual/PricingSe: A pricing section displaying two plan cards—Single Report ($649) and Annual Program ($5,499)—with feature lists and enquire buttons, used on the dedicated annual program page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Institutional footer component rendering brand logo, a services link list (including Annual Program and Our Legacy), and a contact column with email and address, using the useModal hook for enquiry access.
frontend/src/components/home/AnnualProgr: A home-page section showing Single Report and Annual Program pricing cards with feature lists and enquire buttons, similar to the annual page's PricingSection but embedded in the homepage.
frontend/src/components/home/Credibility: A stats section displaying animated count-up numbers (25+ years, 30+ industries, 100% independent) that trigger on scroll, along with a trust quote.
frontend/src/components/home/FinalCTASec: A full-width call-to-action section at the bottom of the homepage with a headline, description, a consultation enquiry button, and a direct email link.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Full-screen hero section with a video background, animated headline, subheading, CTA buttons, and a stats row for the Nexiris Global landing page.
frontend/src/components/home/HowItWorksS: Four-step process section explaining the verification workflow from request submission to report delivery, with scroll-triggered animations.
frontend/src/components/home/ProblemSect: Section highlighting three key trade risks (counterparty risk, regulatory exposure, documentation failures) using animated cards with scroll-triggered visibility.
frontend/src/components/home/TradeScoreS: Displays the proprietary Trade Trust Score™ with an SVG radar chart and progress bars across five verification dimensions.
frontend/src/components/home/WhatWeDeliv: Lists eight deliverables included in a Nexiris verification report in a two-column checklist layout with scroll animations.
frontend/src/components/InquiryModal.tsx: A dialog modal component for submitting consultation inquiries with form fields for name, company, email, and message, including validation, submission via a React Query mutation, and a success confirmation state.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: A fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, smooth-scroll section links, route links to pricing and legacy pages, and a mobile hamburger menu that opens the inquiry modal on enquire.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, switching between anonymous and authenticated actors based on Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: React hook that animates a number from a start to end value over a given duration using requestAnimationFrame, with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for submitting and fetching inquiries from the backend canister actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to return a ref and an `isVisible` boolean when an element enters the viewport, with prefers-reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts, configuring Tailwind base/components/utilities, defining CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, gradient utilities, and scroll animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AnnualProgram.tsx: Page component for the Annual Program, rendering a pricing section and FAQ section with an enquiry modal trigger.
frontend/src/pages/ExportInquiries.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that composes multiple section components (Hero, Problem, WhatWeDeliver, TradeScore, AnnualProgram, Credibility, FinalCTA) and passes the enquiry modal opener to relevant sections.
frontend/src/pages/OurLegacy.tsx: Page describing Nexiris Global's heritage and evolution from Nexiris Consultants, featuring scroll-animated hero, body content, and CTA sections with links to external firm resources.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom brand colors, fonts (Montserrat/Inter), box shadows, border radii, accordion keyframes, and registering the animate and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking version, summary, features, and architectural notes for the Nexiris Global website build.
